description: Answers 'publish this backtest as a public, reproducible strategy page.' Give a spec (same format as run_backtest), a title (1-120 characters) and your hypothesis (what would falsify it); visibility public or private. Returns the new strategy's slug and page URL. Runs the backtest on the server and publishes it at data.finzdata.com/s/<slug>, forward-tracked daily from today; only server-computed results are stored. Costs one backtest; free accounts may publish 3 a day. Free keys publish over the last 12 months; full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

description.description: Hypothesis: why it should work and what would falsify it.
